item.title: Whiskers 0.8.56
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.56

### Transcript History

  • Added paged transcript loading so large history lists stay faster and easier to browse
  • Improved Home controls for recent transcripts with a cleaner, more compact layout

    • ### Dictation Reliability

  • Improved audio capture and speech detection so quiet speech is handled more reliably
  • Improved live dictation stability to reduce missed or incomplete transcript chunks
  • Improved recording audio handling so volume ducking, muting, and restoration behave more consistently during and after dictation
  • Smoothed waveform updates so recording feedback stays steadier while you speak

    • ### Shortcuts & Setup

  • Added a Copy Last Dictation menu bar action so you can quickly reuse your most recent transcript
  • Added direct setup guide links when adding provider API keys, making cloud setup easier
  • Improved AI Enhancement setup and validation so enabled options stay more consistent
